recipes.label: Light
recipes.startdescription:
A light that wells up from the depths of my mind — I can use it to scout for opportunities in a location, or to reveal someone who is hiding.

[This card can be used for rapid reconnaissance or to expose a hidden enemy.]

recipes.label: Reveal the Enemy's Location
recipes.startdescription:
They lurk in the shadows, and I shall force them into the light.

[Use an Ability card that meets the requirements to reveal a hidden enemy.]
recipes.description: The shadows are shattered—there will be no more mercy.

recipes.label: Tracking Longs: Garrisons of Triple Knot
recipes.startdescription:
They know they cannot confront me directly, which is why they maneuver in the shadows and do everything to hinder my goals... What if I force them to step into the light?

[This will consume Trace and offer you a chance to strike back against the hostile group.]

recipes.label: Tracking Base: Garrisons of Triple Knot
recipes.startdescription:
They know they cannot confront me directly, which is why they’ve been establishing outposts all around, trying to accumulate strength behind my back... What if I force them to step into the light?

[This will consume Trace and offer you a chance to strike back against the hostile group.]
